title: Inter Milan Projects Starting Lineup to Face Parma
seoTitle: Inter Milan Projected Lineup vs Parma
subtitle: Coach Mircea Lucescu sets 3-5-2 formation for Saturday's clash at San Siro
excerpt: With the three-week international break over, Inter announce their probable lineup against Parma, highlighting Stankovic and Sucic in midfield and.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Inter Milan have announced their probable lineup for the clash against Parma, scheduled for Saturday, October 10, at 6:00 p.m., at San Siro. The announcement comes right after the conclusion of a three-week break dedicated to international commitments.

Inter's Projected Lineup for the Clash Against Parma

According to SempreInter.com's forecast, the goalkeeper will be Josep Martínez, followed by full-backs and center-backs Pavard, Bisseck, and Carlos Augusto. In midfield, Diouf, Barella, Stankovic, Sucic, and Dimarco make up the five-man line, while Lautaro Martínez and Thuram complete the attacking duo.

The 3-5-2 Tactical Formation

The team maintains the structure of three central defenders, two wing-backs who contribute to both marking and attacking support, and two forwards. This configuration does not indicate a change in approach for Parma, who are also expected to play with three in defense and two up front.

The Role of Stankovic and Sucic in Midfield

Stankovic and Sucic were included in Lucescu's projection as key figures in midfield. The presence of both reinforces the intention to control the transition between defense and attack, providing creative options and defensive cover.

Expectations After the International Break

The return from national team duty has brought difficult decisions for managers, who must balance the players' physical fitness with the need to adjust tactical systems. Inter, under the guidance of Mircea Lucescu, are using this period to consolidate their tactical identity.

Defensive and Offensive Challenges at San Siro

With the defense formed by Pavard, Bisseck, and Carlos Augusto, the team seeks to maintain solidity against Parma's attacks. In attack, Lautaro Martínez and Thuram are expected to exploit the gaps left by the opposing full-backs, supported by Barella and Dimarco pushing forward out wide.

With information from SempreInter.com.
